main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads two sequences, transforms each into a strictly decreasing sequence while rejecting duplicate elements, then computes and prints a modular combinatorial result rounded to an integer." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read two integers from standard input into variables n and m. RESULT n,m]
            [COMMAND Declare integer arrays a and b of size 1003 and declare integer variables i and x. RESULT a,b,i,x]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 through n-1 inclusive, read one integer from standard input into a[i]. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 through m-1 inclusive, read one integer from standard input into b[i]. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Sort array a into strictly decreasing order by an insertion-like pass: for i from 0 through n-2 inclusive, whenever a[i] <= a[i+1], first test whether a[i] equals a[i+1] and if so take the duplicate-in-a alternative; otherwise swap a[i] and a[i+1], and if i > 0 decrement i by 2 before the loop increment so the next effective index backs up one position. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Sort array b into strictly decreasing order by the same insertion-like pass: for i from 0 through m-2 inclusive, whenever b[i] <= b[i+1], first test whether b[i] equals b[i+1] and if so take the duplicate-in-b alternative; otherwise swap b[i] and b[i+1], and if i > 0 decrement i by 2 before the loop increment so the next effective index backs up one position. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Set p = 1000000007, ans = 1.0, k = 0, and declare integer variables y, j, and q. RESULT p,ans,k,y,j,q]
            [COMMAND Begin a descending loop with i from n*m down to the minimum of a[n-1] and b[m-1], inclusive, decrementing i by 1 after each iteration. RESULT i]
            [COMMAND Within the descending loop, set x, y, and q to 0 and set j to 0. RESULT x,y,q,j]
            [COMMAND Within the descending loop, scan array a starting at j = 0 while a[j] > i, incrementing j and x on each scan step; after the scan, if a[j] == i, set x = 1 and increment q. RESULT j,x,q]
            [COMMAND Within the descending loop, reset j to 0 and scan array b starting at j = 0 while b[j] > i, incrementing j and y on each scan step; after the scan, if b[j] == i, set y = 1 and increment q. RESULT j,y,q]
            [COMMAND Within the descending loop, if q == 0 multiply ans by (x * y - k); otherwise multiply ans by (x * y). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the descending loop, set ans = round(fmod(ans, p)) and increment k by 1. RESULT ans,k]
            [COMMAND After the descending loop exits, use its final value of i as the upper limit: for j from 0 through i-1 inclusive, multiply ans by j+1 and then set ans = round(fmod(ans, p)). RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print round(ans) to standard output as an integer with no decimal places, followed by a newline. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During the insertion-like sorting of array a, some adjacent pair satisfies a[i] == a[i+1].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string 0 followed by a newline to standard output. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main immediately. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: During the insertion-like sorting of array b, some adjacent pair satisfies b[i] == b[i+1].]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print the string 0 followed by a newline to standard output. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Return 0 from main immediately. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
